_comment: Read memory through the program buffer and compare against the ELF.
base_addr is the Ibex demo system's SRAM (MEM_START = 0x00100000, see
tb_top_ibex.sv), not CVA6's DRAM base -- the same scenario against a
different memory map. 16 words is enough to exercise the program-buffer
read path without spending JTAG time on a scan that proves nothing extra.
